title: OnlyRoasts
tagline: OnlyRoasts is a hilarious AI-Agent that analyzes your blockchain transactions and roasts you for them. Share the witty burns on social media or turn them into roast frames for others to join the fun!🔥😏 #BlockchainRoasts

description:
OnlyRoasts injects humor and accessibility into the world of blockchain by transforming wallet transactions into witty, AI-generated roasts. It's a unique platform designed to make Web3 less intimidating and more entertaining, blending education, entertainment, and innovation. By connecting your wallet, users can invite distinct Covalent tools, the platform's AI agents, to analyze their blockchain activity and deliver humorous critiques. The aim is to demystify the complexities of blockchain, making it more approachable for a wider audience.

OnlyRoasts uses a seamless entry into Web3, creating a smooth experience. The platform facilitates initial transactions by leveraging server wallets to send initial funds via Privy, removing the common hurdles users face when diving into Web3 experiences. This allows users to explore the platform without immediate financial commitment, encouraging experimentation and discovery.

Furthermore, a chat interface allows users to learn about Web3, ask questions, execute transactions using natural language commands and mint NFTs and explore them using the Graph protocol. This approach breaks down the technical jargon often associated with blockchain, making it easier for beginners to understand and interact with the technology. The focus is on simplifying the onboarding process and providing a supportive learning environment.

OnlyRoasts seeks to be more than just a source of entertainment. It aims to be a gateway to Web3 for the uninitiated, a place where humor and education intersect to create a positive and engaging experience. By making blockchain more accessible and relatable, We hope to foster wider adoption and understanding of this transformative technology.
how_its_made:
Onboarding New Users:
To onboard curious newcomers who come across the buzz around OnlyRoasts, we use Privy's embedded wallet solution, providing a seamless Web3 entry point. To make their first transaction frictionless, we leverage server wallets to send initial funds, empowering users to dive into Web3 experiences without hurdles. Through a chat interface powered by Covalent, users can learn about Web3, ask questions, and perform transactions using natural language commands.

AI-Driven Roasting Platform:
Our front-end is built in React and styled with Tailwind CSS for a sleek user experience. We connect to the GoldRush API to fetch detailed Ethereum transaction data. Using Covalent’s AI Agent SDK and OpenAI's GPT-4, we generate witty, crypto-themed roasts based on wallet activity. A multi-agent workflow powers the platform, where one agent fetches transaction data, and another crafts the perfect roast.

Warpcast Bot Integration:
Users can tag @onlyroasts on Warpcast to generate roasts based on their wallet transactions. The bot replies directly in Warpcast with a clever roast frame. Additionally, users can mint these hilarious roasts as NFTs directly from the replied Farcaster frame, turning blockchain burns into collectible moments.

NFT Minting:
Users can mint their roasts as ERC-721 NFTs via the OnlyRoasts platform or directly from Warpcast. Each NFT encapsulates the roast text, transaction details, and optional custom metadata. We deployed custom smart contracts to handle minting and metadata storage.

This blend of AI-driven humor, blockchain transparency, and creative NFT capabilities makes OnlyRoasts a unique and entertaining Web3 experience that combines education, entertainment, and innovation.
